d:
Amerika ke mid tarm ilekshans ke rijalts men donald tranp aur unki ripablikan parti ko tagra jhatka laga hai. amerika se kyon aa raha hai bare chenj ka maisej? kya tranp ki har sabse karari hai ya pahle bhi ameriki presidents ko aise ya bare jhatke lag chuke hain?
Samjhie bibisi nyuz hindi ke editar nitin shrivastav se.
Editing: mohammad ibrahim
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
(kripya not karen: naya aip briten aur amerika men uplabdh nahin hai.)
